research_questions.statement: Which bounded changes to Evidence-First Research Methodology v0.1 most improve scientific decision quality per unit coordination cost without weakening falsifiability, provenance, or independence?
research_questions.decision_target: Select methodology v0.2 candidates for testing; do not alter validated v0.1 in place.
research_questions.objective: Improve the methodology using the same evidence-first loop it prescribes while preventing recursive process bloat.

residuals.statement: v0.1 requires predeclared outcome interpretations but does not require a demonstrably exhaustive and mutually exclusive scientific verdict partition.
v0.1 outcome tables can over-specify the next architecture instead of reopening the residual and preferring a cheaper discriminating diagnostic.
Shared methodology guidance can contaminate later attempts to measure independent architecture-selection quality.
Steady-state coordination overhead of the methodology has not yet been measured prospectively.
The ordinal Decision Value rubric has not yet been tested for whether it reliably discriminates between multiple eligible experiments.
Self-application can create infinite meta-methodology recursion unless the research object and governing method version are explicitly separated.

hypotheses.statement: Adding an explicit outcome-space exhaustiveness and exclusivity check will catch scientifically meaningful verdict gaps before implementation with low overhead.
predictions: Applied to the original composition design, a formal outcome partition check identifies the uncovered valid state: controls retained, e1.a absent, e6.a absent, execution valid.
Applied to corrected composition design, every valid scientific state is classified exactly once or explicitly delegated to a defined residual class.
The same check distinguishes operational invalidity from negative scientific outcomes.
falsifiers: The check fails to identify the known composition gap.
The check requires project-specific logic so burdensome that it cannot be represented as a small reusable experiment-design requirement.

hypotheses.statement: Reopening the residual after each result and preferring a cheaper discriminating diagnostic before a larger architecture improves next-action calibration.
predictions: A lower-cost diagnostic can sometimes reduce uncertainty after a partial result more effectively than immediate architecture-family selection.
falsifiers: Across prospective cases, diagnostic-depth checks repeatedly add no decision-relevant information and only delay the same architecture choice.

hypotheses.statement: Independent architecture-selection quality requires a sealed or otherwise isolated precommitment channel; shared visible recommendations are insufficient.
predictions: A dual-lane commitment protocol can preserve recommendation identity before reveal while preventing the EXTRACT owner from observing the recommendation.
falsifiers: No practical commitment mechanism can be made durable without exposing the recommendation or adding unacceptable coordination overhead.

hypotheses.statement: Most methodology value comes from scientific-boundary state, mechanism-family memory, frozen interpretation, and stopping rules; applying the full method to routine engineering operations would add cost without scientific benefit.
predictions: Boundary-only use preserves scientific safeguards while operational implementation/CI proceeds without methodology stops.
falsifiers: Repeated operational defects materially alter scientific interpretation and would have been prevented by applying the methodology inside the engineering loop.

hypotheses.statement: Ordinal Decision Value dimensions are sufficient for early methodology use and are safer than an unjustified weighted numeric score.
predictions: When candidate experiments differ materially, ordinal comparisons produce a stable preference without fabricated precision.
falsifiers: Prospective cases repeatedly leave two or more candidate experiments tied or arbitrarily ordered in ways that materially change research decisions.

hypotheses.statement: A single frozen-method-on-method self-study layer is sufficient for controlled methodology improvement; recursive evaluation of the meta-method itself before new evidence would add process without information.
predictions: v0.1 can generate falsifiable v0.2 candidates while remaining frozen as the governing instrument.
Candidate revisions can be evaluated prospectively before adoption without constructing a separate meta-meta methodology.
falsifiers: Material contradictions cannot be resolved without introducing a distinct higher-order methodology.

assumptions.statement: Evidence-First Research Methodology v0.1 remains frozen as the governing instrument during this self-study; proposed changes are v0.2 candidates only.
EXTRACT can generate methodology evidence and counterexamples but one project is insufficient to establish general methodology validity.

mechanism_families.name: Formal scientific outcome partition
mechanism_families.premise: An experiment design can represent valid scientific outcome dimensions explicitly enough to verify coverage, exclusivity, and separation from operational invalidity before execution.

mechanism_families.name: Residual-first diagnostic depth
mechanism_families.premise: After each result, the methodology should reopen the residual state and prefer a cheaper discriminating diagnostic when one can reduce uncertainty before architecture commitment.

mechanism_families.name: Blind methodology commitment
mechanism_families.premise: Independent selection quality can be evaluated by committing a methodology-side recommendation in a channel unavailable to the owning researcher until after both choices are frozen.

candidate_architectures.name: OUTCOME_PARTITION_EXHAUSTIVENESS_V0_2
candidate_architectures.scientific_difference: Adds formal outcome dimensions plus a requirement that all valid scientific states map to exactly one verdict while operational invalidity remains outside the scientific partition.

candidate_architectures.name: DIAGNOSTIC_DEPTH_RULE_V0_2
candidate_architectures.scientific_difference: Changes next-action semantics from a prescribed architecture to an admissible scientific region followed by a fresh cheapest-discriminating-diagnostic check.

candidate_architectures.name: BLIND_DUAL_LANE_COMMITMENT_V0_2
candidate_architectures.scientific_difference: Adds an isolation mechanism for independent architecture-selection evaluation rather than relying on visible shared-state recommendations.

evidence_items.statement: Evidence-First Research Methodology v0.1 is the frozen governing instrument for this self-study.
evidence_items.notes: v0.1 is not mutated in place during this self-study.

evidence_items.statement: The first prospective shadow correctly predeclared ADDITIVE_FRONTIER_PARTIAL and its interpretation but required revision of next-action calibration; architecture-selection independence was not evaluable.
evidence_items.notes: Prospective interpretation evidence; selection independence contaminated.

evidence_items.statement: After the frontier PARTIAL result, a smaller automatic-intent exposure diagnostic classified e1.a as SHALLOW_DISTRIBUTED_EXPOSURE before the next planner design.
The original composed acquisition/preservation design omitted the valid scientific state where all seven controls are retained but neither e1.a nor e6.a is supported.
evidence_items.notes: Caught before implementation by pre-implementation audit.

evidence_items.statement: The corrected composition design adds COMPOSITION_NEGATIVE for the previously uncovered valid state and was independently re-reviewed before implementation.
evidence_items.notes: Experiment mechanics remained unchanged; correction was interpretation-only.

evidence_items.statement: Meta-research explicitly treats research methods and practices as empirical objects to evaluate and improve.
evidence_items.source_identity: Ioannidis et al. 2015, PLOS Biology, doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.1002264

evidence_items.statement: Preregistration separates prediction from postdiction by committing research questions and analysis plans before observing outcomes.
evidence_items.notes: Supports freezing v0.1 as instrument and treating v0.2 changes as prospective candidates.

invariants.statement: Do not silently rewrite Evidence-First Research Methodology v0.1 after observing its evaluation results; preserve it as historical instrument evidence.
Methodology self-research must not prescribe or mutate the active EXTRACT architecture while independent methodology validation is being pursued.

experiment_candidates.target_uncertainty: Whether outcome-space incompleteness is a structural methodology weakness that can be caught cheaply and generically before implementation.
experiment_candidates.discrimination_claim: Apply a formal valid-state partition audit to the known pre-correction composition design and recent neighboring designs. If the audit catches the known missing state without requiring architecture-specific post-hoc knowledge, the candidate is justified for prospective testing.
controls: Frontier and facet-reservation designs as neighboring controls.
frozen_gates: CANDIDATE_SUPPORTED: known missing composition state is detected, corrected design covers it, and the rule can be stated generically with low project-specific burden.
CANDIDATE_PARTIAL: known gap is detected but generic formalization is too ambiguous or requires substantial project-specific encoding.
CANDIDATE_REJECTED: the rule fails to detect the known gap or creates more ambiguity than it removes.

outcome_interpretations.evidence_pattern: Known gap detected and reusable formal rule demonstrated.
outcome_interpretations.interpretation: Promote outcome-partition exhaustiveness to a v0.2 candidate for prospective testing.
outcome_interpretations.authorized_next_action: Draft a candidate schema/validator without modifying v0.1.

outcome_interpretations.evidence_pattern: Gap detected but reusable formalization is weak or costly.
outcome_interpretations.interpretation: Keep as reviewer guidance rather than schema-level methodology requirement.

outcome_interpretations.evidence_pattern: Known gap not detected or rule introduces comparable ambiguity.
outcome_interpretations.interpretation: Do not add outcome-partition formalization to v0.2.

outcome_interpretations.evidence_pattern: Required historical designs or outcome semantics cannot be reconstructed faithfully.

invalidation_conditions: Using the corrected composition verdict to define the audit rule in a way that merely hard-codes COMPOSITION_NEGATIVE.
Modifying v0.1 before the self-study result is classified.
Treating one EXTRACT case as sufficient for canonical methodology promotion.
experiment_candidates.what_pass_authorizes: Only a v0.2 candidate schema/validator for prospective methodology testing.

decision_value.rationale: A known pre-implementation verdict gap provides a strong positive control; the test is cheap, structural, and can fail if generic formalization does not actually recover the gap.

experiment_candidates.target_uncertainty: Whether independent architecture-selection quality can be measured without contaminating EXTRACT.
experiment_candidates.discrimination_claim: Prototype a cryptographic or user-mediated sealed commitment and evaluate whether it preserves durable identity without exposing recommendation content before owner freeze.
frozen_gates: Candidate only; no implementation until higher-priority outcome-partition audit completes.

outcome_interpretations.evidence_pattern: Durable verifiable commitment with bounded user overhead.
outcome_interpretations.interpretation: Eligible for future independent selection trial.
outcome_interpretations.authorized_next_action: Run only at a future architecture boundary.

outcome_interpretations.evidence_pattern: Cannot preserve both secrecy and durable recovery with available tooling.
outcome_interpretations.interpretation: Architecture-selection independence remains not directly measurable in shared workspace.

invalidation_conditions: Revealing recommendation content to EXTRACT before owner freeze.
experiment_candidates.what_pass_authorizes: A future independent selection-evaluation protocol only.

decision_value.rationale: Important for validation credibility but less urgent than a concrete structural defect already observed in v0.1.

stopping_rules.condition: One bounded audit across the known positive-control gap and neighboring designs is completed.
stopping_rules.action: Stop and classify; do not iterate the audit rule to fit every historical design.

decisions.statement: Freeze v0.1 as the governing methodology instrument and place all self-improvement proposals into v0.2 candidates.
decisions.rationale: Changing the instrument after observing its own evaluation results would erase the prediction/postdiction boundary.

decisions.statement: Test verdict-space exhaustiveness before other methodology changes.
decisions.rationale: It targets a demonstrated structural defect, has a known positive control, low cost, low confound risk, and high reuse value.

provenance.hindsight_disclosure: This self-study uses v0.1 as a frozen governing instrument after observing some v0.1 evaluation evidence. It may generate and test v0.2 candidates but cannot retrospectively redefine v0.1 success criteria. EXTRACT remains an observational case unless a future precommitment is independently frozen.
provenance.notes: One meta-level only: v0.1 studies v0.1 as an object. Candidate v0.2 changes are not recursively treated as a new governing methodology until prospectively evaluated.
